name: lingcoo-system-base-framework-workspace
description: Lingcoo Frame packages, reference applications and verification workspace.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @lingcoo/frame-design-tokens && npm run build --workspace @lingcoo/frame-ui && npm run build --workspace @lingcoo/frame-database && npm run build --workspace @lingcoo/frame-extension-sdk && npm run build --workspace @lingcoo/frame-admin && npm run build --workspace @lingcoo/frame-web && npm run build --workspace @lingcoo/frame-cms && npm run build --workspace @lingcoo/frame && npm run build --workspace @lingcoo/frame-example-extension
scripts.build:apps: npm run build:server && npm run build:admin && npm run build:public
scripts.build:all: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test:integration && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint
